newsitem.title: USA: CCC seeks 10,470 tonnes vegoil, rice and flour.
newsitem.headline: CCC seeks 10,470 tonnes vegoil, rice and flour.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp said it was seeking a total of 10,470 tonnes of rice, vegetable oil, sunflower oil and all purpose flour for donation to Kyrgyzstan, Georgia and Bosnia.

The CCC, which is part of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it was tendering 1,500 tonnes rice in 50 kg bags for Kyrgyzstan, 750 tonnes vegetable oil and another 1,450 tonnes vegetable oil, packaged in plastic bottles for Kyrgyzstan.
The tender also included 2,695 tonnes of sunflower oil for donation to Georgia and 1,250 tonnes sunflower oil for donation to Bosnia.
It also comprised 1,075 tonnes all purpose flour for Georgia and 1,750 tonnes flour for Bosnia.
The shipping period for the flour, rice and vegoil was slated for August 21-September 5.
The offers for flour, rice and vegoil was due on August 6, the CCC said.
